The '''lowest common divisor''' is a term mistakenly used to refer to:<ref>{{cite web |title=The least common divisor and the greatest common multiple |url=https://blog.plover.com/math/gcm.html |website=The Universe of Discourse : The least common divisor and the greatest common multiple}}</ref>

*[[Lowest common denominator]], the lowest common multiple of the denominators of a set of fractions
*[[Greatest common divisor]], the largest positive integer that divides each of the integers
